user.title: NibePi
user.description: Connect to a NibePi gateway over MQTT. The MQTT integration must be set up first.

data_description.prefix: config.mqtt.topic on the gateway, e.g. nibe/modbus/

data.price_very_cheap_below: Own threshold: very cheap at or below (öre)
data.price_very_expensive_above: Own threshold: very expensive at or above (öre)
data.weather_forecast_adjust: Shift forecast by measured outdoor temperature

data_description.sensor_timeout: An indoor or outdoor value older than this counts as missing and its component gives 0.
data_description.price_source: Tibber: the Tibber integration's tibber.get_prices action. Entity attributes: a Nordpool or similar price sensor.
data_description.tibber_home: The home's nickname in the Tibber app. Only needed when the Tibber account has several homes.
data_description.price_entity: Nordpool (raw_today/raw_tomorrow or today/tomorrow) or Tibber-style attributes (startsAt/total). Only used with the entity attributes source.
data_description.price_unit_factor: 100 when prices are in SEK/kWh (Tibber, most sensors), 1 when they are in öre/kWh.
data_description.price_very_cheap_below: Set both thresholds to replace the optimiser's level.

data.indoor_entity: Indoor temperature sensor, e.g. Netatmo (empty = pump's BT50)
data.price_guard: Only lower at expensive levels while indoor is warm enough

data_description.indoor_entity: Recommended: a room sensor such as Netatmo's indoor module. Staleness is judged by its last report, so an unchanged value is not stale. Left empty, the pump's BT50 room sensor (register 40033/40032) is used.

data.price_guard: Only lower at expensive levels while indoor is warm enough

tibber_missing.title: Tibber prices are not available
tibber_missing.description: NibePi is set to read electricity prices with the tibber.get_prices action, but the Tibber integration is not set up or not loaded. Set up the Tibber integration, or choose another price source in NibePi's options. Until then the price component contributes 0.
